text:
Alex Chen: Quick triage — we need final alignment on launch commitments for Monday. Specifically: SLA targets, pricing buckets, support coverage, and runbook handoff. Who owns what?

Mira Patel: I can own the SLA doc and the acceptance checklist. Will update the draft by EOD. :white_check_mark:

David Ortiz: Billing note — we need explicit rules for burst vs sustained usage. Current matrix doesn't cover sustained 10k rps; that changes unit economics.

Sofia Ramos: Monitoring proposal: p95 latency <120ms for hosted, error rate <0.5%, and an automated regression alert tied to our eval prompt set. Also split telemetry for text-gen vs embeddings.

Alex Chen: @Sofia 👍 for hosted SLOs. For Dedicated let's allow target bump (p95 <200ms) but keep error <0.3%. Add fallback model behavior in SLO exceptions.

Priya Singh: Support coverage: GA = 24x5 with SRE escalation on sev2+ for the first 90 days. Someone needs to author the canary rollback runbook.

Mira Patel: I'll attach a runbook skeleton to the SLA PR. Proposed rollback steps:
```
- cut traffic to canary
- switch routing policy to fallback model
- scale up dedicated pool if autoscale available
- notify stakeholders + create postmortem ticket
```

David Ortiz: For pricing I'm drafting three buckets: dev (free/low-rate), standard (pay-as-you-go), dedicated (commit + discount). Need an overflow policy if autoscale runs wild. Will run a finops sim and share numbers.

Sofia Ramos: Telemetry checklist to include: token-level cost, KV-cache hit rate, batch sizes, model-variant fallback counts, and per-route p95. Those feed Redwood Optimize suggestions.

Alex Chen: Two action items: SLA final wording (owner Mira) and billing overflow policy (owner David). Also Legal signoff required on data residency text before we list Private availability.

Priya Singh: I'll run a 30-min handoff with support + oncall tomorrow at 10:30 UTC. Support runbook owners: @Priya + @Alex. Will prepare customer communication templates for overflow situations.

OpsBot: Deploy window reserved: 2026-04-05 02:00-04:00 UTC. Please ack if launch requires that window.

Alex Chen: Acked.

Mira Patel: Quick question — do we promise latency SLAs for embeddings or mark them as "best-effort" for GA?

Sofia Ramos: Mark embeddings as best-effort for GA. We'll publish median numbers in docs and commit to p95 for Dedicated in a subsequent release.

David Ortiz: Billing backstop idea: if autoscale spend exceeds 150% of committed for a customer, we notify them and give 72h to adjust, otherwise throttle non-critical routes. Need product + legal signoff.

Alex Chen: Product ok with that conservative backstop. @Priya make sure customer templates are ready and that CS knows the escalation flow.

Priya Singh: Will post templates in #customer-success and sync with support team after the handoff.

Mira Patel: I'll open the SLA PR now and ping reviewers when ready.

Alex Chen: Thanks team — recap of owners: SLA=Mira, Billing policy=David, Monitoring=Sofia, Support & runbook=Priya+Alex. We'll reconvene after SLA PR review. :rocket:
